title: Principles of good governance and its role in the effectiveness of Jordanian political parties: a study of two principles (quality of legislation, participation and accountability)
core_idea: Identify and analyze two principles of good governance—quality of legislation, and participation and accountability—and their role in enhancing the effectiveness of Jordanian political parties, using descriptive-analytical, legal, and comparative approaches.
tldr: The study examines how legislative quality and participation/accountability as governance principles affect the effectiveness of Jordanian political parties through descriptive-analytical, legal, and comparative analysis.
